headline: Palace Extends Alternative Work Setup to Tuesday in NCR and 13 Luzon Provinces
seoTitle: Palace Extends Alternative Work Setup to Aug. 18 | FMB News
seoDescription: Government executive offices in NCR and 13 Luzon provinces will continue alternative work arrangements Tuesday, August 18, amid Habagat rains.
deck: The extension keeps flexible arrangements in place for executive offices while essential frontline services continue on site.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Malacañang extended alternative work arrangements for government executive offices in Metro Manila and 13 Luzon provinces through Tuesday, August 18, as Habagat rains and localized flooding persisted.
The evening newsroom brief listed Bulacan, Pampanga, Bataan, Zambales, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, Pangasinan, Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal, Quezon and Occidental Mindoro alongside NCR.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Frontline health, disaster-response, law-enforcement, fire-protection and vital-service personnel remain subject to operational requirements rather than the general remote-work arrangement.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The extension affects government-worker travel and public-office operations on Tuesday while authorities continue to assess weather and flooding risks.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Check agency-specific instructions and local advisories before travel because implementation may differ for essential functions and local offices.

sources.title: Gov't shifts to alternative work setup in NCR, 13 areas Tuesday
